items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: He's a big clenny with Jack Hale-Band. Yeah. I never did know what come of him.

ctx.x: Get it, son. What was his first name? Huh? What was his first name? Joe Tick, I think Joe Robeshow. Joe Robeshow, yeah. Joe Robeshow, yeah. Yeah. He's a big clenny with Jack Hale-Band. Yeah. I never did know what come of him.
I got a little notebook here. Oh, ask him what's the difference in funerals now from the old days.
